$comment: no $schema key on purpose: the claude CLI's --json-schema validator (measured 2026-09-15, live fire) refuses a draft/2020-12 $schema ref — 'no schema with key or ref'; the shape is draft-07-compatible and validate() mirrors it by hand
title: rehearsal build tree
description: One cold read of a ticket by the cheapest reader (ticket cf80bdb57205, D5). The reader's job is the TREE, never code; cannot_proceed is a legal answer. The identity fields (ticket, ticket_sha256, read) are stamped from truth by the machine after the shape is checked, never trusted from the reader.

step.description: the ticket decision this step builds, by id: D<n> (the n of an entry in the ticket's decisions list) — or 'unlisted: <text>' for a step no decision covers, which is itself a gap the ticket owes a decision for

assumption.description: empty when builds_as_written; otherwise the one thing the ticket left unsaid that this step rests on

would_settle.description: the one-line decision that, added to the ticket, would make this step builds_as_written
